g.text: Chancellor Valeria, who keeps the King's purse in the palace in
Springport, might have work for someone the Crown trusts.
- Able to defeat a level 20 monster
Rickshaw! Take it once round the ring through all eight districts, and I'll tell you what's what
in each. Five coins, and I set you down right back here.
I'm very busy. What is it you need?
Quest complete: Trouble at the Crossing!
